# Math and ufuncs

Runnable examples from `examples/math/` (executed on both backends by the gate).

## out-parameter

Write ufunc results into a preallocated array with the out= parameter (no new allocation).
NumPy: np.sqrt(x, out=buf); np.multiply(x, 2, out=x)  (in place)

Useful in hot loops / queued jobs where you reuse one buffer instead of allocating each call.
out is passed positionally here (works identically on both backends).

```php
--8<-- "examples/math/out-parameter.php"
```

## ufuncs

Element-wise math (ufuncs), scalar and array broadcasting. Runs on both backends.
NumPy: a + 1; np.sqrt(x); a.prod(); np.add(mat, col) broadcasting (3,) over (2, 3)

Scenario: turn a series of monthly simple returns into growth factors and compound them,
then a little broadcasting. ND/M are the FFI or extension classes depending on the backend.
